entities.name: Marta García Martín
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Marta García Martín is a Spanish chess player, who achieved the FIDE International Master qualification in 2019. She currently belongs to the C.A. Mislata Lanjarón Discema team from Mislata, Valencia. Garcia won the Spanish Women's Chess Championship in 2022 and 2025. She was the No. 3 ranked Spanish female player as of June 2023.

entities.summary: Marta García Martín is a Spanish chess player, who achieved the FIDE International Master qualification in 2019. She currently belongs to the C.A. Mislata Lanjarón Discema team from Mislata, Valencia. Garcia won the Spanish Women's Chess Championship in 2022 and 2025. She was the No. 3 ranked Spanish female player as of June 2023.
